Please look more closely. A huge portion of the community does not even know that this proposal *exists* and thus cannot possibly be said to actually (rather than "apparently") satisfy everyone.

To the rest of the community (not specifically to @strahncryptography) I want to point out that I am noticing that this is the root of the disagreements I've been made aware: you all need to be *a lot* more careful about who you include when you say "everyone." If "Zcash is for everyone" then, by definition, you need to carefully consider people who are not currently Zcash "stakeholders" or "coinholders," because those people are also people worthy of "infinite civilization money."

It's starting to feel like what many of you really mean is "Zcash is for everyone in the room that I feel comfortable being in." That is not "everyone" money. That is just…fiat, again.

[Please slow down](https://forum.zcashcommunity.com/t/future-dev-and-legal-defense-fund-zip/58611/10).
